## Four new features shipped & verified (verified with end-to-end tests against the backend)

- **Narrated streamed answers (Ask)**: added Deterministic | Narrated toggle. Narrated mode streams a live narration from `/brain/llm/stream` (SSE) with client-side pacing and a Stop button. Note this deployment uses a built-in simulator, so the answer carries a **"Simulated (not model inference)"** badge.
- **Impact Paths (Graph Explorer)**: new Explore | Impact-paths mode — users can pick source and target entities and trace shortest paths via `/graph/shortest-paths`; renders a path subgraph plus a paths-list panel (hop-by-hop chips → inspector).
- **Saved Views (Graph Explorer)**: allows saving/opening/deleting named graph views (seeds + lens + fact filters), persisted per `{principal, tenant, workspace}`, labeled "Saved on this device only".
- **Ingestion Console (new /ingestion screen + nav)**: includes tabs for Ingestion runs (real run records with vertex/edge counts & status), Jobs (cancel/readmit), Sources (+16-connector catalog), and Dead-letter queue.

All connected to real `/api/v1/*` data, TypeScript strict mode enforced, services currently healthy. The streaming narration remains clearly **SIMULATED** as no external or local inference model is active in this deployment.

Please test these features and let me know if any issues arise or further refinements are needed.

- Next Action Items:
  - **Path Highlight**: Highlight traced paths directly on the full neighborhood graph for better visibility.
  - **Evidence Pinning**: Enable pinning key evidence snippets into a side panel to support case building.
  - **Source Onboarding**: Add a guided flow to help users register a connector and run baseline ingestion.
  - **View Sharing**: Support exporting and importing saved graph views to facilitate team collaboration.
